oracle.note: Observable CLI, readiness, authentication and health compatibility only; the Rust root is a reconstruction, not a source port.

determinism.clock: The product reaches the named grapt-store SystemClock adapter only after read-only readiness and successful self-probe.
determinism.identifiers: The product reaches the named grapt-store OsRandomIds adapter only after read-only readiness and successful self-probe.
determinism.network: Every witness uses literal loopback, one ephemeral bind and one bounded self-probe attempt.
determinism.filesystem: The gate reads this fixture and disposable service roots; the positive witness proves database bytes are unchanged.

record_contracts.actions: One executable witness owner and test name per closed IA0 case.
record_contracts.durable: One terminal outcome row per case; absence and identity mismatch remain refusals rather than fabricated success.
record_contracts.state: The sorted case set and count recomputed from actions and durable rows.

evidence.claim: A Ready store serves one authenticated health route, self-probes exact identity, registers after attribution, preserves database bytes, drains and releases.
A damaged store refuses before bind, election, registration or lock creation.
A 200 response with a mismatched build never becomes an attributed probe.
The manifest is validated against the ratified schema file and every declared case is closed over executable owners, durable outcomes and derived state.
